events.text: Diagnosed: running dev host (build 3856) predates commit 54353c436 — __mesh_topo_mirror_quads absent from the binary (string-probed /proc/<pid>/exe); TSX button hot-reloaded but host door missing → silent no-op. Verified algorithm offline against the live mesh via read-only seat dump: 402 quads, 334 already symmetric, 9 fusable. Awaiting user rebuild to confirm live.

resolution: The quads button silently doing nothing had two stacked causes: (1) the first two rebuilds raced the commits so the host door was missing while the hot-reloaded button existed — the UI now says 'host door missing, rebuild' explicitly; (2) once the door existed, discovery found the twin pairs but Merge Faces' coplanarity gate (dot>=0.9999, ~0.1mm) refused every import-warped pair (specimen 3.7mm out of plane) — fixed with mergeSelectedTrusted (gate off for licensed mirror copies) and stats-bearing receipts. f8bf00539.
